sources.title: termic.dev
sources.finding: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0), runs locally with no account or backend; spawns real agent CLIs in PTYs; downloads for macOS, Linux AppImage and Windows 11 x64 (experimental).

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 335 stars, license reported as AGPL-3.0, homepage termic.dev, not archived, pushed 2026-11-16.

sources.title: Termic README
sources.locator: headline; Install; What it does; Sandbox; Status; Roadmap; License
sources.finding: Desktop app running real claude, codex, agy, copilot, grok, opencode, pi, omp, Muse, Devin and Cursor CLIs in separate git worktrees with optional macOS Seatbelt or Docker sandbox, Kanban board, diff review, PRs, CLI and MCP server, schedules, LAN pairing; macOS 12+, Linux AppImage, Windows experimental; AGPL-3.0-or-later; roadmap lists mobile app, Apple Containers, Linear and opt-in telemetry as planned.

sources.title: GNU AGPL v3
sources.locator: header; Cargo.toml and package.json license fields
sources.finding: GNU Affero General Public License v3 text; package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml and termic-cli/Cargo.toml declare AGPL-3.0-or-later.

sources.title: Package manifest
sources.finding: Frontend on React with xterm.js terminals and Tauri 2 API; license AGPL-3.0-or-later.

sources.title: Tauri backend manifest
sources.locator: tauri 2 with tray-icon, notification, dialog plugins; license
sources.finding: Rust backend on Tauri 2 (native webview) with notification and dialog plugins; license AGPL-3.0-or-later.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.finding: Dated shipped changes per release; 1.23.0 adds agent-driven pairing, batched PR status polling and crash log helpers.

sources.title: Sandbox design
sources.locator: Seatbelt; Docker mode; YOLO interaction; Settled
sources.finding: Per-task macOS Seatbelt cage with network allowlist proxy; Docker mode container cage (experimental, egress not restricted); YOLO auto-on inside cages; Secrets roles.

sources.title: Every state an agent tab can be in
sources.finding: Agent states working, working with delegated work, done, attention, interrupted derived from hooks and PTY signals; bell on done and attention.

sources.title: Windows
sources.locator: status and Not on Windows yet
sources.finding: Windows 11 x64 experimental: NSIS installer, not Authenticode-signed, Docker mode is the sandbox, some features missing.

sources.title: LAN pairing
sources.finding: Experimental pairing of computers on one network with a four-digit code; agents can drive tasks on the peer; off by default.

sources.title: Agent accounts
sources.finding: Several logins per agent in separate folders; switch a task mid-conversation; Termic never sees credentials.

sources.title: Adding an agent
sources.finding: Editable agent registry for custom PTY agents beyond the built-ins.

sources.title: Driving Termic from an agent
sources.finding: Instructions block and runtime discovery for agents to use the termic CLI; caged agents are excluded; termic help --json lists every command.

sources.title: Data model
sources.finding: Local JSON state (projects.json, tasks/, settings.json) in the app data directory and global peers.json written 0600.

sources.title: Agent customizations
sources.locator: skills, MCP servers and personas per profile
sources.finding: Skills, MCP servers and personas kept per profile and added to tasks for claude, codex and agents reading .agents/.

sources.title: MCP idea notes
sources.finding: Phase A MCP endpoint shipped in 1.0.0; scoped per-task tokens are an undecided idea.

sources.title: MCP server
sources.locator: tools_list; task_new, task_send, task_wait, task_result, task_review, schedule_*, peer_*
sources.finding: MCP tools mirror the CLI verbs: task_list/status/new/review/send/wait/result/log/diff/archive, scratchpad_*, project_*, schedule_*, peer_*; bearer-token authentication and Host/Origin checks.

sources.title: CLI control plane
sources.locator: local socket server for the termic CLI
sources.finding: Control-plane server behind the termic CLI: new, tab, send, status, wait and more over a local socket.

sources.title: termic CLI
sources.finding: termic CLI with documented verbs, JSON and stream-json output, exit codes and attach/detach.

sources.title: Schedules
sources.finding: Recurring and one-off scheduled runs with catch-up for missed slots; each run is a new task.

sources.title: Forge integration
sources.finding: PR/MR status and creation for GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps through each forge CLI sign-in.

sources.title: Seatbelt sandbox implementation
sources.finding: Generates Seatbelt profiles and runs the hostname-allowlist CONNECT proxy; macOS only.

sources.title: Docker sandbox implementation
sources.finding: Runs agents in a container as the host user with capabilities dropped and a PID cap.

sources.title: Process monitor
sources.locator: per task CPU, memory, output rate
sources.finding: Activity view data: CPU, memory, output rate and uptime for each agent, shell and run script.

sources.title: Agent usage windows
sources.finding: Reads provider plan usage windows for the footer and optional account switch at 95 percent.

sources.title: Secrets roles
sources.finding: Experimental secrets: agent holds a placeholder and Termic swaps the real credential for allowed hosts and API calls.

sources.title: Agent hooks
sources.finding: Installs small hooks into agent configs so tab states come from the agent.

sources.title: Repository config
sources.finding: Setup, run scripts, preview URLs and sandbox allowlists loaded from a committed .termic.yaml.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles and SSO
sources.locator: grep -Eni saml|oidc|rbac|sso|multi-user over src, src-tauri/src, docs, README
sources.finding: No accounts, roles, SSO or multi-user collaboration; the only multi-machine feature is the pairing of one person's computers.

sources.title: Bounded search: vendor cloud, mobile and headless
sources.locator: grep -Eni hosted|vendor cloud|ios app|android app|headless over src-tauri/src, README, docs/ideas
sources.finding: No vendor cloud and no headless server; the mobile app (#165) and headless boxes (#82) are planned or idea-stage only.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.finding: No telemetry sender exists; README lists opt-in usage telemetry as a planned item, off by default; only local crash logs exist.

sources.title: Bounded search: native issue tracker
sources.locator: grep -Eni issue tracker|backlog|priority|labels over src, src-tauri/src
sources.finding: No native issue entity with priority or labels; tasks are worktree tasks and Todos lists GitHub/GitLab issues and PRs.

sources.title: Bounded search: living specifications
sources.locator: grep -Eni living spec|requirements|drift over README, docs, src
sources.finding: No persistent requirements or drift detection; docs/plans and docs/ideas are repository docs for Termic itself.

sources.title: Bounded search: spend, token and time limits
sources.locator: grep -Eni max budget|spend limit|token limit|timeout over src-tauri/src, docs
sources.finding: No product spend, token or time cap; plan usage windows are informational with an optional switch to another login at 95 percent.

sources.title: Bounded search: release, deploy, rollback, revert and delivery evidence
sources.locator: grep -rniE 'screenshot|rollback|revert|deploy|gallery|gh release|stale.*approv|invalidat|recording' over src, src-tauri/src, termic-cli, docs and README.md, excluding ideas, plans, tests, locales and changelogs
sources.finding: No screenshot capture, recording, gallery, release, deployment, rollback, revert or approval-invalidation feature found for delivered work. Matches are unrelated UI strings and comments (an optimistic UI flag reverted on IPC failure, Spotlight restoring a detached HEAD, a secrets role named Deploy in a test, an icon gallery in secrets roles). The screenshot match in automation.rs is a debug-build-only localhost test bridge armed by TERMIC_AUTOMATION=1, not a user feature.

sources.title: Dev-only automation bridge
sources.locator: module header (lines 1-30): armed only for debug builds with TERMIC_AUTOMATION=1
sources.finding: A localhost HTTP bridge (info, eval, screenshot, raise, quit) with a token exists for agent-driven end-to-end testing of the app; it is armed only when a debug build runs with TERMIC_AUTOMATION=1, and release builds refuse to run it.
